findings: `article.learner.overview.text` says the moon-and-window form is associated with “moonlight,” but the cited research interprets that image as moonlight entering a room, not as a settled original meaning for 明; the overview also leaves the window’s disputed sound role unstated despite naming that alternative construction. Revise to say the early forms are interpreted as sun and moon associated with brightness or dawn, or moonlight entering through a window, while preserving that these are competing interpretations (X-782d94a9d4850607d32f, X-e45bc7ca7a6df92e2cf6, X-e9a6f423b02b9be8fe1d, X-23a89ca53c2de2903f2c).
